author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Satyameva Jayate (सत्यमेव जयते) — Mundaka Upanishad III.1.6
explanation: Deceit, manipulation, and falsehood may win temporary skirmishes in the marketplace of vanity. But under the long arc of cosmic law (Dharma), untruth inevitably crumbles under its own hollow weight. Truth requires no defense; it simply outlasts the storm.
practicalInsight: Speak the absolute truth in all your dealings today, even if a minor white lie seems more convenient in the moment.
reflectionPrompt: What uncomfortable truth have you been avoiding or distorting, and what freedom would speaking it bring?
